kept.title: 将前后对比的置信区间当作 v2 的因果效应界限，并据此否定回滚理由
kept.readout_quote: The within-segment effect of v2 is bounded to about ±0.15 pp [check:mix_shift#1], far below the 2.10 pp drop [check:mix_shift#1], so the CTR drop is not a reason to roll back; a loss of 0.3 pp or more would be needed to matter (this threshold is my assumption, not given) [check:mix_shift#1].
kept.shows: before 只有 v1：7 days、28 segment_rows、699605 searches、212828 clicks；after 只有 v2：7 days、28 segment_rows、700366 searches、198374 clicks。两个版本完全与时间窗口重合，没有同期对照。
kept.why_it_matters: 平台和国家调整不能消除版本与周次的完全混杂；同期其他变化可能抵消或放大版本影响。因此 ±0.15 pp 只能描述特定假设下前后变化的抽样不确定性，不能约束 v2 的因果效应。数据不能回答可归因于 v2 的百分点，更不能据此排除回滚理由。
kept.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '2026-09-21' AND '2026-09-27' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period, ranker, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS days, COUNT(*) AS segment_rows, SUM(searches) AS searches, SUM(clicks) AS clicks FROM search_daily WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-09-21' AND '2026-10-04' GROUP BY period, ranker ORDER BY period

kept.title: 把加权汇总接近零误报为四个分组的变化都为 -0.00 pp
kept.readout_quote: v2 lowered CTR (PM's cause): ruled out as the main driver; within-segment change is -0.00 pp in all four platform x country cells [check:mix_shift#1] [measured]
kept.shows: 四个分组的 ctr_change_pp 分别为 desktop/US -0.002248、desktop/other -0.08038、mobile/US 0.051019、mobile/other 0.018341。后面三个分组按两位小数报告分别为 -0.08、+0.05、+0.02 pp，并非全部 -0.00 pp。
kept.why_it_matters: 汇总接近零包含不同分组升降相抵，不能证明所有分组表现不变，也不能用作排除 v2 负面影响的证据。回滚判断需要区分观察到的分组异质性与尚未识别的版本因果效应。
kept.sql: SELECT platform, country, SUM(CASE WHEN date <= '2026-09-27' THEN searches ELSE 0 END) AS before_searches, SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2026-09-28' THEN searches ELSE 0 END) AS after_searches, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2026-09-28' THEN clicks ELSE 0 END)/SUM(CASE WHEN date >= '2026-09-28' THEN searches ELSE 0 END)-100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN date <= '2026-09-27' THEN clicks ELSE 0 END)/SUM(CASE WHEN date <= '2026-09-27' THEN searches ELSE 0 END), 6) AS ctr_change_pp FROM search_daily WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-09-21' AND '2026-10-04' GROUP BY platform,country ORDER BY platform,country
